name: Urea carbamate condenser
description: High-pressure exchanger where ammonia and carbon dioxide from the stripper recombine into carbamate, releasing heat that is recovered as steam. Pool-condenser designs carry the reaction further in the condenser itself, which reduces the duty left for the reactor and the recycle section.
applications: urea synthesis, high-pressure carbamate formation and heat recovery
